title: AskJev
description: Ask Jev a yes or no question and get a probability back. Add one more detail and watch it change its mind.

title: Writing Grader
description: Paste a draft and get it graded for defensive, wordy, and jargon-heavy writing. Uses Jev by TypeSafe to assess.

title: Three Speeds
description: How long does it take AI to write the U.S. Constitution? Watch it happen at speeds from 10 to 17,000 tokens per second.

title: Private.
description: Finds and redacts personal info with a small model running locally. 14x faster than the fastest hosted OpenAI model I tested.

title: Slobo Score
description: Scores your writing by how surprising each word is to a language model. Built to catch AI slop, it ended up rewarding short, direct writing.

title: A Page for You
description: A website that makes itself up for whoever is visiting. No two visitors get the same page.
